style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

qualityCriteria.definitionOfGood: A rounded low blue/cyan stone shelf with purposeful readable slab construction, broad soft non-directional lighting, and clean same-profile repeatable joins in every required facing and actual intended size.

Rebuild the interior/crown/secondary forms freely within locked envelope; original blank loft, three straight crack sticks and four-part topology are not constraints. Preserve the exact true W/E finite section, not a tall-wall form.

Blue/cyan original palette family with clear soft cyan upper surfaces, readable mid-blue body and restrained darker recesses; secondary pebbles/accents may be distinct but subordinate. Material and shape separation survives logical128cell and phone32cell. Avoid a near-black dead bottom band, muddy merged stone faces or uniform flat cyan expanse.

Broad soft non-directional highlights and gentle modeled plane transitions reveal volume in all four orientations. No preferred horizontal lighting direction, directional ground shadow, sharp white stripe, blown glossy patch or target-derived emissive halo. The dark lower portion retains readable form. Exact shader/light method is editor-owned within registered capture and family continuity.

A few clear major slab breaks, rounded stones, chips or dimples make the ledge feel intentionally built; details support scale and form. Avoid evenly spaced rod-like marks, noisy tiny pits and added detail invisible at use size. Embed/flatten taller target-inspired elements to keep the native0.45 height envelope.
